propositions: A peer-confirmation record store must persist vendor link id, direction, confirmed pass, and timestamp for each managed link to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones
The confirmation write callback must be invoked after set_relationship succeeds in _update_one_dispatch_links, with any callback exception logged and swallowed to prevent outbound link failures
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording to avoid persisting vendor keys in local-id fields
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to ensure confirmation-only changes are committed and survive snapshot compaction
Load failures on corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json must degrade gracefully to an empty store without aborting the reconciliation pass
